name: Dielectric
tagline: Designs PCBs from plain English using computational geometry plus AI reasoning, outputting KiCad files.

awards: Best Use of Grok for Real-Time Data/Signal Analysis by xAI

problem: PCB design automation lacks good thermal and placement tooling, the solo builder found.
solution: Voronoi diagrams, spanning trees and convex hulls analyse component layout and thermal hotspots while a multi-agent model reasons about placement, producing KiCad files.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe an audio amplifier and get a laid-out board.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Grok for Real-Time Data/Signal Analysis by xAI” among 195 submissions.
Combines classical algorithms with model reasoning.
A solo builder with prior research experience.

lessons: Classical algorithms around an LLM make its output checkable.
